newsitem.title: USA: Sea Containers to build S.C. plant.
newsitem.headline: Sea Containers to build S.C. plant.

text.p: Sea Containers America Inc said Thursday it plans to build a new factory in South Carolina, initially creating 180 new jobs.

The factory, to be called Charleston Marine Containers Inc, would be located in part of the larger Charleston Navy Yard complex which was closed down a few years ago under defense cuts, the company said.

The facility would be built on eight acres in the Charleston Naval Dockyard. A 25-year lease was signed Thursday with the Charleston Naval Redevelopment Authority, which was created to bring commercial customers into the Navy yard.
